r.name: Standedge Circuit Walk, Marsden Moor
r.description: This challenging circular, largely on the Pennine Way, explores the landscapes of Marsden Moor. Discover valleys & reservoirs, open moorland with far-reaching views, & wind back to Marsden along the old packhorse route & Huddersfield narrow canal. Uneven

r.name: Pule Hill Walk, Marsden Moor
r.description: A circular that starts along the canal towpath before gently contouring around the sides of Pule Hill. You can experience Marsden's past, present & future, with remnants from the area's industrial heritage, incredible views & a peek at its new woodlands

r.name: Marsden Deer Hill Walk, Marsden Moor
r.description: Start in Marsden before climbing up onto the moors for far-reaching views from the tops. Follow Deer Hill conduit, with the option of an added detour to Deer Hill Reservoir, before winding down back to Marsden through Wessenden Valley.

r.name: Eastergate Return Walk, Marsden Moor
r.description: An easy, return walk following the red waymarkers along the canal towpath through quiet winding lanes before reaching the historic Eastergate bridge. Take care with children near the canal edge as the water can be deep with a muddy base.
